instruction: Capture a screenshot of the playing video and save it as 'trailer_frame.png' on the Desktop. Make sure the file is not empty.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires saving a non-empty screenshot file. Evaluator checks if file size is within reasonable range (>1KB, <10MB). Verified by checking file size is greater than 1000 bytes to ensure it's not empty.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts image file properties including size_bytes from the specified path /home/user/Desktop/trailer_frame.png
Metric correctly compares size_bytes against min_size (1000) and max_size (10000000) range
All instruction requirements are verified: file existence, correct filename/location, and non-empty constraint (min_size > 1KB)
Metric parameter handling is correct: directly accesses expected.get("min_size") which works correctly when expected.type="rule"
Edge cases properly handled: file not found returns None, metric handles None by returning 0.0
Expected value range [1KB, 10MB] is semantically appropriate for a PNG screenshot verification
